lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular clusters arranged in a grid-like pattern posterior to the gill slits. The spots are organized in approximately six discernible vertical columns with four visible horizontal rows on the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance circular blobs, creating a grid-like arrangement of nodes across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge feature runs across the upper third of the visible flank, showing a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular notch visible on the posterior trailing edge of the visible pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, dark-colored organisms attached to the ventral-lateral region posterior to the pectoral fin.
